frame.origin: centre of the reproduced district, tunnel floor plane
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR; the readme's rule is ground = z - 10 m (the STL's terrain under the points is at z = 5 m)
frame.wind_direction_rotation: compass FROM-direction (N = 0, E = 90), so N blows toward -y; flow_dir = (-sin WD, -cos WD). Not stated by the sources; supported by the reference-building choice and by upwind roughness, and at NNW by a solved field (status 'corroborated by a solved field'; the other directions stay 'unverified').

column_meaning.point_id: the tunnel's own measurement point number
column_meaning.config: configuration key: 'default', Case C centre building '0D'/'1D'/'2D', Case E state 'bc' (before) / 'ac' (after construction)
column_meaning.wind_direction: compass name of the direction the wind comes FROM (Case E)
column_meaning.wind_direction_deg: AIJ wind direction in degrees; 0 is the case's reference direction (see frame)
column_meaning.velocity_ratio: dimensionless, mean speed over the case's reference speed (Case E: Vs / U(15.9 m), U(15.9 m) = 3.935 m/s; see the case's normalisation)
column_meaning.campaign: 'wind_tunnel' (model scale) or 'field' (a full-scale observation: Cases F, G, M)
column_meaning.velocity_ratio_sd: standard deviation of velocity_ratio over the observations behind a field value (Case F)
